text:
Agent: SkyBridge Airlines, this is Hannah. How may I assist?
Passenger: Hi, I just landed in Chicago and my connecting flight to Denver left without me. My first flight was an hour late.
Agent: I'm sorry about that. Can I have your confirmation code?
Passenger: Yes, it's K, three, T, nine, Q, W.
Agent: Thank you. I see it. You were booked on the 5:40 to Denver. Since the delay was on our end, we'll rebook you at no charge. The next flight with seats is at 8:15 tonight.
Passenger: Okay. Is there anything earlier? I've got a meeting at nine tomorrow.
Agent: I can put you on standby for the 6:50, but no guarantees. And I'd confirm you on the 8:15 so you have a seat either way.
Passenger: That works. What about my bag?
Agent: Your checked bag will be transferred automatically. I'll flag it. You'll also get a meal voucher for fifteen dollars.
Passenger: Thanks. Where do I pick it up?
Agent: At the customer service desk at gate B12. I'm sending the new boarding pass to your email now.
